Production cleanup/error precedence is correct and the absorbed readout matcher now rejects inert comment/string predicates, but the strengthened cleanup regression still searches raw Luau source. evidence: PR #486 exact head 0a9005d079304a971f316d6cc0e37c8d6dd5017f was re-fetched immediately before verdict and remained unchanged, mergeable, and open.

Production runToggleEvidence() pins the exact diagnosticsRoot(lab.model) after successful enable(), asserts it non-nil before the enabled-window pcall, destroys that exact pinned Instance if the protected validation fails, rethrows cycleResult immediately, and performs strict disable/off-state validation only on the success path.

The absorbed physics_lab_diagnostics_readout_contract.luau correctly converts source to an executable-contract form that masks line/long comments and quoted/backtick/long-bracket string bodies, and adds negative mutants for all four inert-text families.

physics_lab_diagnostics_toggle_failure_cleanup.luau still reads raw DIAGNOSTICS_SOURCE into sweepSource and uses string.find/string.match directly. An inert long comment or string inside runToggleEvidence can contain the exact 'local ownedRoot = diagnosticsRoot(lab.model)', non-nil assertion, and 'if not cycleOk then ownedRoot:Destroy(); error(cycleResult, 0); end' text after the executable statements are removed, satisfying the current matcher and ordering checks without executable cleanup.

The defect is a regression-seal integrity gap, not a newly observed production cleanup failure. Required repair is to run cleanup proofs against executable-only/scoped source (reuse/generalize the readout masking approach or equivalent) and add negative inert-comment/string mutants for the exact pin/direct-cleanup sequence.

GitHub API refused a formal REQUEST_CHANGES review because the connected account owns PR #486. Review 4935547340 was therefore submitted as COMMENT with the same exact-head blocker; this swarm REVIEW_RESULT is the authoritative REQUEST_CHANGES verdict and does not misstate GitHub review state.

Known TextTransparency/readout-renderability finding #496 remains a separate published follow-up and is intentionally not used as this review blocker. No Studio/viewport/contact/performance-device/two-client evidence is run or inferred.
